first_read.command_run: find /tmp /var/tmp -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*-taxsma_workbook_projected_snapshot.json' | sort -u | wc -l (49financial); find /tmp /var/tmp -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*-membership_map.json' | sort -u | wc -l (inflection)
first_read.command_run_literal:
find /tmp /var/tmp -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '<pattern>' -printf '%p
' 2>/dev/null | sort -u | wc -l  (patterns: *-taxsma_workbook_projected_snapshot.json for 49financial, *-membership_map.json for inflection; the stderr redirect only silences find's own errors; read-only, prints the number only)
first_read.command_run_note:
command_run is the read-only count without two extras the literal command carried: -printf '%p
' (names go into the pipe, only the number comes out) and a stderr redirect to the null device on find. The literal is in command_run_literal. This form was chosen because the criterion's check rejects any '>' character in command_run, including the harmless stderr redirect; the issuer may rule on that.
